title: glTF 2.0.1
supported_use: Format semantics; no universal MB or triangle performance limit.

title: Khronos Asset Creation Guidelines 2.0
supported_use: Source/delivery, instancing, seams, textures, animation; several full chapters remain WIP.

title: Khronos 2020 creation guidelines
supported_use: The <5 MB / 100k triangle advice is commerce publishing guidance, not a modern populated-scene limit.

title: KHR_texture_basisu
supported_use: KTX2 ETC1S/UASTC, color spaces, mips, device-dependent transcode and non-color fallback.

title: EXT_meshopt_compression
supported_use: Buffer-view compression includes geometry, morphs, animation and instance transforms.

title: KHR_draco_mesh_compression
supported_use: Mesh-primitive geometry codec, not arbitrary animation/texture/LOD optimization.

title: KHR_mesh_quantization
supported_use: Smaller vertex storage; illustrative PBR layout 48 to 20 B/vertex; precision and consumer support.

title: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing
supported_use: Repeated geometry with fewer calls; node reuse and GPU instancing differ.

title: KHR_meshopt_compression
supported_use: Do not silently replace EXT in pinned r180.

title: meshoptimizer
supported_use: Cache/fetch/quantization ordering, attribute discontinuities and hardware-dependent overdraw gains.

title: gltfpack
supported_use: Optimization can change hierarchy, material, animation and quantization; test emitted asset.

title: Basis Universal
supported_use: Universal GPU transcoding differs from JPEG/WebP; quality, target format and overhead matter.

title: glTF Transform CLI
supported_use: Inspect and use controlled individual transforms, not only broad optimize presets.

title: glTF Transform textureCompress
supported_use: Resize/transcode by texture use with explicit size and quality.

title: Three.js textures
supported_use: Compressed image file size differs from GPU allocation; RGBA with mips approx w*h*4*4/3.

title: Three.js many objects
supported_use: Submission and scene graph overhead; combining objects has trade-offs.

title: Three.js Material
supported_use: Double-sided transparent two-pass behavior; forceSinglePass is not universally visually safe.

title: Three.js InstancedMesh
supported_use: Shared geometry/material and bounds.

title: Three.js LOD
supported_use: Distance switching/hysteresis; thresholds are application-specific.

title: Three.js disposal
supported_use: GPU and ImageBitmap lifetime; shared resource ownership/ref counting.

title: Three.js shadows
supported_use: Extra scene passes; point-light shadow uses six views.

title: Three.js on-demand rendering
supported_use: Avoid continuously rendering unchanged inspection views.

title: Three.js renderer source
supported_use: Default info reset follows shadows; autoReset=false/reset once for all-pass accounting.

title: Three.js counter source
supported_use: Memory values are counts; triangles multiply instanceCount.

title: Three.js GLTFLoader
supported_use: Explicit Draco/Meshopt/KTX2 setup; supports EXT_meshopt.

title: Three.js KTX2Loader
supported_use: detectSupport and target-format selection; transcoder deployment.

title: MDN WebGL best practices
supported_use: No portable max-VRAM query; physical pixels, memory/caches, mips/compression.

title: MDN disjoint timer query
supported_use: Optional GPU timing; reject disjoint results; use corresponding WebGL2 API when applicable.

title: Unity mobile art optimization
supported_use: Silhouette first, material LOD, tiny/static assets may not need LOD; independent map sizes.

title: Unreal mobile performance
supported_use: 500k triangles/700 calls text tied to old iPad4/Air ~30fps, not WebGL baseline.

title: PlayCanvas optimization
supported_use: Rough low-end mobile 100–200 calls; shaders, DPR, alpha, shadows, on-demand rendering.

title: model-viewer loading
supported_use: Poster/lazy loading, decoder cold cost and dynamic resolution.

title: model-viewer API
supported_use: Model-count cache is not a byte limit.

title: Khronos Asset Auditor
supported_use: Use-case profiles distinct from format validation.

title: glTF Validator
supported_use: Conformance does not establish beauty, scientific correctness or frame rate.

title: Blender glTF exporter
supported_use: UV/hard-normal seams split runtime vertices; exportable material graph.

title: Khronos official sample assets
supported_use: Fox, DamagedHelmet, FlightHelmet exact file/mesh metadata; not FPS or quality rankings.
